title: clearfelt-writing eval manifest
description: Documents tests/fixtures/eval/manifest.json's shape, read by scripts/eval.mjs. Not a validation engine this repo runs against the file (see CLAUDE.md's dependency-free rule; scripts/lint.mjs does a small hand-written check instead, not generic JSON-Schema interpretation). Primary purpose: editor autocomplete/validation via the manifest's own "$schema" field, and a single documented source of truth for the shape instead of only prose.

note.description: Explains this is a machine-written manifest, not a hand-edited rule/config file, and what the score bands mean.

label.description: Ground-truth label: is this fixture AI-heavy or human-written prose.

expectedMin.description: The Human Score this fixture should meet or exceed. Used for human-labeled fixtures.

expectedMax.description: The Human Score this fixture should be at or below. Used for ai-labeled fixtures.

bucket.description: Optional self-labeled content-type tag (e.g. "support", "executive", "sensitive"), not a multi-reviewer-panel label. Added on ai-6/human-6 onward, absent on earlier fixtures.
